codeReviewIssues.description: tools/config/__init__.py changed from `from .config_manager import *` (star re-export) to `from . import config_manager, enhanced_config_manager` (module import). This subtly changes the public API: previously `from reveng.tools.config import ConfigManager` would work via star import, now only the module objects are exposed. No current code relies on the old star-import behavior (tests use `from reveng.tools.config.config_manager import ConfigManager`), so this is non-breaking but worth noting as a semantic change beyond shim removal.

In enhanced_health_monitor.py line 186, the module string was updated to 'reveng.agents.ai.ai_enhanced_analyzer' (a fully-qualified path) while the other entries in the same list still use short unqualified paths like 'tools.corporate_exposure_detector'. This inconsistency is pre-existing but the diff made it more visible. Not introduced by this feature.

Worker handoff reported 'successState: partial' because the worker did not commit (repo-wide lint/mypy were red). The commit was later made by another process. The skill's guidance about scoped lint was already documented but the worker ran repo-wide lint first, wasting time before discovering the scoped approach. The skill file was subsequently updated with clearer guidance (see SKILL.md line about 'Lint and typecheck scope for cleanup features').
